title: Jet Lag Overnight Eye Serum for Fine Lines & Wrinkles with Gentle Retinol Blend

specifications.Breadcrumbs: Eye Creams & Treatments > Eye Care > Skincare
specifications.ingredientPreferences: retinoid, sulfateFree, crueltyFree, cleanAtSephora, parabenFree, fragranceFree, squalane, vegan

descriptionHtml:
✓ Vegan✓ Good for: Loss of firmness✓ Good for: Anti-Aging✓ Clean at Sephora✓ Retinol✓ Hydrating

What it is: An overnight eye serum that hydrates, and with a gentle retinoid blend, visibly minimizes fine lines for a smoother, firmer look.


Skin Type: Normal, Dry, Combination, and Oily


Skincare Concerns: Dryness, Fine Lines and Wrinkles, and Puffiness


Highlighted Ingredients:
- Glycerin: Attracts and locks in moisture that helps skin feel soft and supple.

- Retinol and Retinyl Linoleate: Improves the appearance of fine lines and is gentle for all skin types.

- Licorice Root Extract: Soothes the look of irritation and reduces the look of puffiness.


Ingredient Callouts: Free of parabens, formaldehydes,

How to Use+

Suggested Usage:
-In the evening, gently apply a small amount around the contour of each eye.

Ingredients+

-Glycerin: Attracts and locks in moisture that helps skin feel soft and supple.

-Retinol and Retinyl Linoleate: Improves the appearance of fine lines and is gentle for all skin types.

-Licorice Root Extract: Soothes the look of irritation and reduces the look of puffiness.


Glycerin, Water/Aqua/Eau, Squalane, Caprylic/Capric Triglyceride, Isodecyl Neopentanoate, Hydrogenated Polydecene, Pentylene Glycol, Rosa Canina Seed Oil, Propanediol, Sodium Acrylates Copolymer, Borago Officinalis Seed Oil, Oenothera Biennis (Evening Primrose) Oil, Ceramide NP, Bisabolol, Avena Sativa (Oat) Bran Extract, Glycyrrhetinic Acid, Centella Asiatica Extract, Phospholipids, Retinyl Linoleate, Retinol, Tocopheryl Acetate, Tocopherol, Glycine Soja (Soybean) Oil, Gluconolactone, Polyglyceryl-10 Stearate, 1,2-Hexanediol, Lecithin, Maltodextrin, Potassium Sorbate, Caprylhydroxamic Acid, Trisodium Ethylenediamine Disuccinate, Levulinic Acid, Sodium Levulinate, Benzyl Alcohol, Sodium Benzoate.


The list of ingredients is subject to change, please consult the packaging of the product purchased.
